snippet.title: Dwarves: Idle Battles - First Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A physics-based idle auto-battler where every click counts, every Dwarf matters, and endless possibilities await.

- Upgrade your clicker powers or opt for complete idling
- Legendary loot that transforms the gameplay
- Deck building synergies without cards

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4175710/Dwarves_Idle_Battles/
